purpose: 重新從完整80開局數值證據辨識下一輪策略值得驗證的瓶頸；不新增實測、不變更歷史結果、不宣稱可重播原世界。

originalGoal.latestQualification: 本輪原始測試開始時查得的最新版 v2.22
originalGoal.confirmationCriterion: each candidate/version independently at least6/12 fresh wins under its frozen protocol

scope.primaryComparisons: confirmation cohorts kept separate by strategy and game version
scope.descriptiveFailureCensusNote: Across-policy failure-type counts describe workload only and do not define a common candidate or pooled success rate.

methods.outcomes: Reclassify native final title/description/resultSeconds; blank result plus visible elapsed>150 and stated cutoff reason is deadline_cutoff. Missing native finals use existing identified reviewer sidecars only.
methods.denominator: Every recorded start retained; original screen-02 recovery slots map explicitly to original07/08; no replay/replacement.
methods.diagnosticWindows: Posthoc, declared for this research read: last10 saved samples for deaths; elapsedVisible121..150 inclusive for late cutoff comparisons; first savedHUD>=186. Samples are not independent trials.
methods.growthCheckpoints: First saved sample in [requested visible elapsed, requested+1]; absent remains null and is not imputed.
methods.distribution: Median and linear-interpolated percentiles of recorded values; no predictive inference.
methods.wilson: Two-sided nominal95%Wilson per candidate/version/phase, z=1.959963984540054; not adjusted for candidate selection or multiple comparisons.
methods.winningTime: Visible settlement Play time, not final HUD elapsed or wallMs.
methods.sourceVerification: Selected original input files checked against frozen CHECKSUMS; all80 identities/outcomes compared independently to archived summary;64focus start hash fields checked against frozen candidate manifests.

primaryFailureCensus.scope: v2.22 only, confirm-03/04/05; descriptive across three separate policies

findings.status: observed failure distribution; research priority is an inference
findings.statement: v2.22 三個獨立確認批次各12局，合計作失敗類型盤點時有16次死亡及7次到時。16次死亡的結算HUD及所有保存sample最大HUD均低於186；7次到時有4次未在保存sample達186、3次曾達186。主要已觀測非成功負擔集中在186以下生存／成長。
findings.limitation: This is a descriptive census across distinct, selected policies; it is not a pooled policy success estimate or proof of causal priority. HUD sampling cannot reveal unrecorded frames.

findings.statement: 16次確認死亡中，11次最後10個保存樣本的預測clearance全正；另外5次只有最後保存樣本為負且reason=escape，前9個仍為正。
findings.limitation: clearance is the chosen short-horizon model prediction, not measured separation. Last persisted samples are not exact fatal frames; complete hazard lists, tracking IDs, flags and intervening decisions are missing.

findings.statement: confirm-05-04的HUD195從124秒保存樣本到150秒樣本及151秒停止紀錄不變；18個已選本體NPC樣本均geometryAccepted=0、localReliable=false，免疫階段30樣本mapOnly=0。保存的近接觸ETA/gain預測沒有對應後續可見成長。
findings.limitation: No evidence establishes that repeated targets are the same NPC, physically inedible, truly in contact, or the causal source of the stall. Existing blocked/stalled tracker state is absent from logs.

findings.statement: confirm-03-18與confirm-05-02在HUD121–150秒窗口的平均辨識food分別23.07及25.9；HUD分別132→156與132→161。這兩局持續成長但到時未達200。Late失敗不能一律以辨識食物稀少或scout主導描述。
findings.limitation: Recognized counts are model outputs, not actual world density. They do not measure route accessibility or obtainable gain.

findings.statement: Grow15 v2.13為11/12；v2.22 Grow15、16各5/12，Grow17為3/12。三個v2.22確認批次都未達原固定6/12門檻。不能把不同候選或探索局混入確認，也不能以點估計排序推因果優劣。
findings.limitation: Natural seeds unknown; no paired worlds; candidates selected using preceding exploration; small independent confirmation samples have wide Wilson intervals.

findings.statement: Grow15–17的64個原始開局均有native final；各final釋鍵欄為true，compute數量等於decisions，時值有限且均低於200ms，controllerEvents空。沒有這些紀錄可指向的超時計算或基礎設施失敗。
findings.limitation: This does not establish absence of every timing, input or rendering issue. The two infrastructure cases in the80-start original census belong toGrow14 and remain non-successes.

nextRoundEvidenceRequirements.hypothesis: 186以下的安全預測／控制反應仍有可改進缺口。
nextRoundEvidenceRequirements.why: F1/F2 failure distribution and saved prediction/outcome disagreement.
nextRoundEvidenceRequirements.discriminatingEvidence: New fixed candidate and prospective games; save bounded numeric visible-derived hazard records and chosen path at control cadence around terminal events, including radius interval, velocity, visible color/label, clipping, hard/soft classification and chosen path clearance. Preserve distinct estimated IDs, compute/input state and raw visible final. No hidden world state.
nextRoundEvidenceRequirements.notEstablished: The current logs cannot distinguish radius error, unseen/merged hazards, association error, velocity prediction, collision model, control timing or unavoidable path.

nextRoundEvidenceRequirements.hypothesis: 在預測接觸但可見HUD長時間不增加時，目標持續性與失敗追逐處理可能影響最後幾點。
nextRoundEvidenceRequirements.why: F3 independently verified stall despite zero immune-stage scouts.
nextRoundEvidenceRequirements.discriminatingEvidence: Before a new fixed test, bounded numeric logging of visible-derived target identity/match history, x/y, confidence interval, stalled/blocked state, selected target changes, predicted gain and observed HUD/eaten progress; explicitly distinguish failure memory reset from target change.
nextRoundEvidenceRequirements.notEstablished: Do not replay planner from these target-only historical samples or assert selectedNPC was physically inedible.

nextRoundEvidenceRequirements.hypothesis: 有食物辨識且持續成長的截止失敗，需要檢查實際可見成長速度與安全折衷。
nextRoundEvidenceRequirements.discriminatingEvidence: For future fixed batches retain full started denominators, growth checkpoints and realized progress; compare only newly predefined policies/versions without excluding slow deaths or reusing exploratory outcomes.
nextRoundEvidenceRequirements.notEstablished: Detected food count alone does not establish accessible resource abundance or identify a correct change.

limitations: This is posthoc research on archived numeric evidence, not a new acceptance test or a causal experiment.
Do not pool exploration with confirmation or combine different policies/versions to claim the original goal.
Natural seeds are unknown and trajectories are not paired. Changes in observed rates or failure patterns cannot be attributed to a single code change from these samples.

Saved per-visible-second samples omit intervening100ms decisions, complete scenes/hazards, stable object IDs, target x/y and stalled/blocked state. No exact reconstruction or counterfactual replay is possible.

The final HUD can lag the last successful swallow; classify success from the visible result. HUD-derived elapsed is commonly one second greater than resultSeconds. DeadlineHUD is observed at151, not precisely at150.
Predicted clearance/gain/ETA and geometry confidence are model quantities. Clearance1000000 is a no-hard-hazard sentinel, not real separation; gains from overlapping horizons must not be summed.
Recognized food/NPC counts are perception outputs, not ground-truth world density or unique counts.
Growth checkpoint summaries condition on having saved samples. No missing sample is replaced with zero or last-observed values.
ConfirmedGrow15v2.13evidence belongs toGrow15; Grow16/17have no newv2.13games.
The original full80includes2reviewer-classifiedGrow14infrastructure failures without nativefinals; these remain in denominators and are not recast as deaths/cutoffs.
This analysis does not establish current live-site version at time of research; it uses exact frozen v2.13/v2.22game hashes.
